decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8am to 11:00pm Sunday to Friday8am  to 12pm Saturday.

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for a restaurant shall not begin until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the restaurant and the office units adjacent, has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The measures so approved shall be implemented prior to the use commencing and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - A scheme for the ventilation of the restaurant shall be submitted for approval in writing by the local Planning Authority. The approved scheme shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved details before the use commences and thereafter maintained in accordance with the approved details.
description: Change of use of ground floor from A1(retail) and 1st floor of no's 32 & 34 from A2 (financial) to A3 (restaurant) use.
